description: REQUIRES prior shinhan_easy__auth__id_password_session__login call with same account_link_id. Search Shinhan easy-inquiry transaction history for one account.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

bank_account_credential_id.description: Opaque bank-account credential selected by the user

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch; default 20, max 100
